niche: Psychology & human behavior (biases, habits, social dynamics)

ideas.title: Why Everyone Is Not Staring At You
ideas.angle: This video exposes the Spotlight Effect, revealing how your brain hallucinates that strangers are judging your every micro-movement. It surprises viewers by proving that people barely remember what you wore an hour ago.
ideas.reason: High search volume around social anxiety and self-consciousness combined with an immediate counter-intuitive pattern interrupt hook guarantees high 3-second retention.
sources: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology

ideas.title: Why Future You Always Gets Screwed Over
ideas.angle: This video breaks down Present Bias, showing why your brain views your future self like a completely different stranger. It explains why you endlessly procrastinate and sabotage tomorrow for a tiny dose of today's comfort.

hook.en: Your brain thinks future you is a stranger.

ideas.reason: Procrastination and financial regret are universal daily frustrations. Frame it as neurological betrayal rather than laziness to trigger massive shareability.
sources: Hal Hershfield fMRI Future Self Studies

ideas.title: Why Having Too Many Options Ruins Your Life
ideas.angle: This video explores the Paradox of Choice, demonstrating how adding just a few more options to a decision actually increases anxiety and stops people from pulling the trigger.
ideas.reason: Everyone experiences choice fatigue daily from streaming platforms to supermarket aisles, making the insight immediately relevant and viral.
sources: Barry Schwartz The Paradox of Choice
